# AutoMode

> AutoMode is a free, open source plugin for Claude Code that picks the model (Haiku, Sonnet or Opus) and the effort for each prompt. It sets a code-defined quality floor for risky work, reviews risky changes, and checks the prompt cache cost before a model switch. It needs no API key and no server. In five mixed coding sessions with hidden tests, it cost $2.01 against $4.14 for Claude Code on Opus, with all 20 steps passing.

AutoMode is a community project, not made by Anthropic. It is not Claude Code's built-in auto mode, which is a permission mode.

Install in Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add mralexivy/AutoMode`, then `/plugin install automode@automode`, then `/reload-plugins`.

- [Home](https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/): what AutoMode does, the benchmark summary and FAQ
- [Benchmark](https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/benchmark/): costs and pass rates against Opus, Sonnet high and effortless, with method and limits
- [Cost calculator](https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/calculator/): estimate monthly spend on Opus, Sonnet high, effortless and AutoMode from measured per-step costs
- [Claude Code effort levels explained](https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/effort-levels/): what low to max do, defaults, and how to set them
- [Haiku vs Sonnet vs Opus in Claude Code](https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/haiku-vs-sonnet-vs-opus/): which model fits which task, with measured costs
- [How to reduce Claude Code costs](https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/reduce-claude-code-costs/): nine ways, with sources
- [Install](https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/install/): requirements, steps, troubleshooting and removal
- [How it works](https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/how-it-works/): how a route is decided, the ladder, the risk bands and the workflow
- [Compare Claude Code routers](https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/compare/): AutoMode, effortless, jev-router, claude-router and others
- [AutoMode vs effortless](https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/automode-vs-effortless/)
- [AutoMode vs Claude Code Router](https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/automode-vs-claude-code-router/)
